info.title: Ticket Tailor Universal API
info.description: Sell tickets, manage events, and track orders with Ticket Tailor

get.description: Retrieves a checkout form element from Ticket Tailor.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Ticket Tailor checkout form ID.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
